appDescription: An app that explains dashboard warning lamps by voice using the Hyundai owner's manual and tells the driver whether to stop now, drive to a rest area, or check after arrival.

function.name: TELL_ACTIVE_WARNING_LAMPS
function.description: Tells the driver by voice which dashboard warning lamps are on now and what the owner's manual says to do.

function.name: REPEAT_LAST_GUIDANCE
function.description: Repeats the most recent warning lamp guidance that this app spoke.

function.name: FIND_NEARBY_REPAIR_SHOP
function.description: Finds the nearest car repair shop from the current location, preferring Hyundai Bluehands shops, and tells its name and distance by voice.
